items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: Adolph, though? [INTERVIEWER] Adolph, yeah, his brother.

ctx.x: So what happened with the band? You went on up north with her?

We went on up and after we got up there, we got to St. Paul, Minnesota. We didn't give them no dance there, we went right on in the Chippewa 4. We stopped at the Ottawa Hotel. And the whole time we were there, about two or three days we rehearsed, you know. And the booking agent lived in that town, Mr. Lyons, that's his name, Mr. Lyons. Well, he come down when we got the band all ready, he listened to it. And then we got out on the road then. Steven pointed the highway in, we played all out that way. Waterloo,…
